movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Men carry horns, shields, and spears; women carry small wooden axes or unsharpened sticks.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Women form a procession flanked by men.

signature_moves.description: Ululations performed by the lead woman to initiate the dance.
signature_moves.name: Kigila

signature_moves.description: A mock fight movement performed by the lead man.
signature_moves.name: Owoc

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the sound of drums accompanying vocal war songs, yelling, and high-pitched ululations.

basic_steps: Kigila: A vocal ululation initiated by the lead woman.
Owoc: A mock fight movement initiated by the lead man.
Procession: Women form a line flanked by men.
teaching.formation: Women form a procession flanked by men.
